#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class FastReader {
public:
    FastReader() {
        ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);
    }
    int nextInt() {
        int value;
        cin >> value;
        return value;
    }
    string nextLine() {
        string line;
        getline(cin, line);
        if (line.empty()) getline(cin, line);
        return line;
    }
};

class TaskB {
public:
    enum State {
        OUTSIDE_NO_WORD,
        OUTSIDE_WORD,
        INSIDE_NO_WORD,
        INSIDE_WORD
    };
    
    void solve(int testNumber, FastReader& in, ostream& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        string s = (in.nextLine() + '_').substr(0, n + 1);
        State state = OUTSIDE_NO_WORD;
        int wordsInside = 0;
        int wordLen = 0;
        int maxOutside = 0;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s[i];
            bool delimiter = (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')');

            switch (state) {
                case OUTSIDE_NO_WORD:
                    if (delimiter) {
                        if (c == '(') state = INSIDE_NO_WORD;
                        else if (c == ')') state = OUTSIDE_NO_WORD;
                    } else {
                        state = OUTSIDE_WORD;
                        wordLen = 1;
                    }
                    break;

                case OUTSIDE_WORD:
                    if (delimiter) {
                        if (wordLen > maxOutside) maxOutside = wordLen;
                        wordLen = 0;
                        if (c == '(') state = INSIDE_NO_WORD;
                        else if (c == ')') state = OUTSIDE_NO_WORD;
                        else state = OUTSIDE_NO_WORD;
                    } else {
                        wordLen++;
                    }
                    break;

                case INSIDE_NO_WORD:
                    if (delimiter) {
                        if (c == '(') state = INSIDE_NO_WORD;
                        else if (c == ')') state = OUTSIDE_NO_WORD;
                    } else {
                        state = INSIDE_WORD;
                        wordLen = 1;
                    }
                    break;

                case INSIDE_WORD:
                    if (delimiter) {
                        wordsInside++;
                        wordLen = 0;
                        if (c == '(') state = INSIDE_NO_WORD;
                        else if (c == ')') state = OUTSIDE_NO_WORD;
                        else state = INSIDE_NO_WORD;
                    } else {
                        wordLen++;
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }
        out << maxOutside << " " << wordsInside;
    }
};

int main() {
    FastReader in;
    TaskB solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, cout);
    return 0;
}
